description: Renew one active claim through the hosted claim API (extends the lease). App-aware like claim_via_api. REPORT-MODE SAFE: dry run unless execute is true; executing needs a stored token or the token argument.

api_base.description: Override the hosted claim API base URL.

execute.description: Post the heartbeat for real. Defaults to false: dry run returns the plan only.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

mode.description: Renew with a comment or a reaction, where supported.

token.description: API token passthrough; prefer the stored token from greenlight auth login.

name: heartbeat_via_api
